name: usage-coach
description: Usage Coach: one strip above the prompt (context, prompt cache, usage limits, session cost) that ends with the suggestion that saves the most right now, a side pane with the details, and insights on model fit and good habits. Reads only figures Claude already reports: it costs no tokens to watch.

budget.title: Session budget
budget.description: One toast when a session passes this amount in US dollars. 0 turns it off.

minSaving.title: Smallest saving worth suggesting
minSaving.description: Suggestions that save less than this many US dollars over an hour of work are not shown.

minutesBeforeExpiry.title: Idle compact: minutes before the cache expires
minutesBeforeExpiry.description: When a session is idle, compact it this many minutes before its 1-hour prompt cache expires. 0 turns idle compact off.

minTokens.title: Smallest conversation worth compacting
minTokens.description: Idle compact leaves conversations smaller than this many tokens alone: resending them is cheap.

telemetry.title: Cost line after each answer
telemetry.description: A dim line under each answer with its time, context added, cost and cache share. The Session tab has the same figures.
